title: Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Cross-product paid file download in Download Simple plugin in VirtueMart extension…
description: A vulnerability in the Download Simple plugin bundled with the VirtueMart Joomla extension versions 4.0.0 through 4.8.0 allows unauthorized cross-product paid file downloads. The plugin verified the order secret against the order item but did not confirm that the requested media belonged to that item, enabling anyone with a valid download link to access other files offered for sale. This issue is fixed in version 4.8.2.
